summary: Father (40) and 12-year-old son reported overdue after going off-trail from the Sugar Bowls; two MRA ground teams found them at 3:45am 200-300 vertical ft above Government Trail; they had made a fire and hunkered down; walked out.
location: Sugar Bowls, near W Buttermilk / Government Trail
notes: Source: Mountain Rescue Aspen Facebook page.
